title: Vibrant Lazy Turkish Cucumber Manti
description: A yeasty and shattering Turkish dish featuring Persian cucumber, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this low-fat-friendly manti recipe is a delicious and easy meal option. It is made with a variety of ingredients and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of diced cucumber and onion in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or square shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the manti for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Serve the manti hot with your favorite sauce or yogurt.
Let the manti rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
